# Research Report: English Wikipedia — Most Relevant Articles, Titles, and URLs

Below is a curated record of the most relevant English Wikipedia articles and pages matching the key terms, grouped by theme. All URLs are canonical `en.wikipedia.org` addresses (underscores replace spaces per standard MediaWiki URL formatting).

## 1. Core Encyclopedia Articles

| Title | URL | Relevance |
|---|---|---|
| **English Wikipedia** | https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/English_Wikipedia | Main article on the English-language edition (founded 15 January 2001; largest Wikipedia edition by article count) |
| **Wikipedia** | https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia | Main article on Wikipedia as a whole — the free, web-based, collaborative encyclopedia operated by the Wikimedia Foundation |
| **History of Wikipedia** | https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/History_of_Wikipedia | Origins (Nupedia, Jimmy Wales, Larry Sanger), 2001 launch, growth milestones |
| **List of Wikipedias** | https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_Wikipedias | Meta-list of all active language editions with article counts, edits, and statistics |

*Note: the main-namespace article "Wikipedia" should not be confused with the project page "Wikipedia:About" or same-titled pages in other namespaces.*

## 2. Content Policies and Guidelines (Article Quality)

| Title | URL | Shortcut |
|---|---|---|
| **Wikipedia:Notability** | https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia:Notability | WP:N |
| **Wikipedia:Verifiability** | https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia:Verifiability | WP:V |
| **Wikipedia:Neutral point of view** | https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia:Neutral_point_of_view | WP:NPOV |
| **Wikipedia:No original research** | https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia:No_original_research | WP:NOR |
| **Wikipedia:Identifying reliable sources** | https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia:Identifying_reliable_sources | WP:IRS |

The middle three (WP:V, WP:NPOV, WP:NOR) are collectively known as Wikipedia's **core content policies**; Notability is the key inclusion guideline, and WP:IRS is frequently cited alongside them.

## 3. Reliability, Criticism, and Academic Coverage

| Title | URL |
|---|---|
| **Reliability of Wikipedia** | https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Reliability_of_Wikipedia |
| **Criticism of Wikipedia** | https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Criticism_of_Wikipedia |
| **Wikipedia in popular culture** | https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia_in_popular_culture |
| **Academic studies about Wikipedia** | https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Academic_studies_about_Wikipedia |
| **Ideological bias on Wikipedia** | https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ideological_bias_on_Wikipedia |
| **Gender bias on Wikipedia** | https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Gender_bias_on_Wikipedia |
| **John Seigenthaler Wikipedia biography controversy** | https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/John_Seigenthaler_Wikipedia_biography_controversy |
| **Essjay controversy** | https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Essjay_controversy |
| **Wikipedia Review** | https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia_Review |

*Reliability of Wikipedia* covers the landmark 2005 *Nature* study comparing Wikipedia with Encyclopædia Britannica; the Seigenthaler and Essjay articles document the two most cited reliability/credibility controversies.

## 4. Statistics and Rankings

**On English Wikipedia:**
- **Wikipedia:Statistics** — https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia:Statistics (main statistical hub)
- **Wikipedia:Size of Wikipedia** — https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia:Size_of_Wikipedia (article-count growth over time)
- **Wikipedia:Multilingual statistics** — https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia:Multilingual_statistics
- **Wikipedia:Multilingual ranking** — https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia:Multilingual_ranking
- **Wikipedia:Modelling Wikipedia's growth** — https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia:Modelling_Wikipedia%27s_growth
- **Wikipedia:Size comparisons** — https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia:Size_comparisons
- **Special:Statistics** — https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Special:Statistics (live counters)

**Cross-project and comparison lists:**
- **Wikimedia Statistics** — https://stats.wikimedia.org/ (official dashboards: pageviews, editors, new content)
- **List of Wikipedias (Meta-Wiki)** — https://meta.wikimedia.org/wiki/List_of_Wikipedias (300+ editions ranked by article count)
- **List of online encyclopedias** — https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_online_encyclopedias
- **List of wikis** — https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_wikis
- **List of most-visited websites** — https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_most_visited_websites

**Most-viewed article lists:**
- **Wikipedia:Top 25 Report** — https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia:Top_25_Report (weekly ranking of the 25 most-viewed articles)
- **Wikipedia:Pageview statistics** — https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia:Pageview_statistics
- **Pageviews Analysis** — https://pageviews.wmcloud.org/ (per-article pageviews; topviews at https://pageviews.wmcloud.org/topviews/)

*Live figures change daily — use Special:Statistics, stats.wikimedia.org, or the statistics API (https://en.wikipedia.org/w/api.php?action=query&meta=siteinfo&siprop=statistics&format=json) for current numbers.*

## 5. How Searching Wikipedia Works

| Title | URL |
|---|---|
| **Help:Searching** | https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Help:Searching |
| **Help:CirrusSearch** | https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Help:CirrusSearch |
| **Help:CirrusSearch** (MediaWiki.org) | https://www.mediawiki.org/wiki/Help:CirrusSearch |
| **Extension:CirrusSearch** (MediaWiki.org) | https://www.mediawiki.org/wiki/Extension:CirrusSearch |
| **MediaWiki** | https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/MediaWiki |
| **Wikipedia:Search engine optimization** | https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia:Search_engine_optimization |
| **Special:Search** | https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Special:Search |
| **Wikipedia:Search engine test** | https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia:Search_engine_test |
| **Elasticsearch** | https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Elasticsearch |

**Key technical facts:** Wikipedia's search is powered by **CirrusSearch**, a MediaWiki extension running on an **Elasticsearch** cluster (it replaced the older Lucene-search backend in 2014). Search syntax supports phrase matching, exclusions, fuzzy/wildcard matching, namespace filters, and ~20 keywords (`intitle:`, `insource:`, `incategory:`, `deepcat:`, `hastemplate:`, `linksto:`, `morelike:`, etc.). "Wikipedia:Search engine optimization" (WP:SEO) is distinct — it concerns external engines' crawling and indexing of Wikipedia.

3. History of Wikipedia — https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/History_of_Wikipedia
4. List of Wikipedias — https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_Wikipedias
5. Wikipedia:Notability — https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia:Notability
6. Wikipedia:Verifiability — https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia:Verifiability
7. Wikipedia:Neutral point of view — https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia:Neutral_point_of_view
8. Wikipedia:No original research — https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia:No_original_research
9. Wikipedia:Identifying reliable sources — https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia:Identifying_reliable_sources
10. Reliability of Wikipedia — https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Reliability_of_Wikipedia
11. Criticism of Wikipedia — https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Criticism_of_Wikipedia
12. Academic studies about Wikipedia — https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Academic_studies_about_Wikipedia
13. Wikipedia:Statistics — https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia:Statistics
14. Wikipedia:Size of Wikipedia — https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia:Size_of_Wikipedia
15. Wikimedia Statistics — https://stats.wikimedia.org/
16. Help:Searching — https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Help:Searching
17. Help:CirrusSearch — https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Help:CirrusSearch
18. MediaWiki — https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/MediaWiki

*Caveat: these titles and URL patterns are long-standing, stable canonical addresses; page content and live statistics may have been updated since retrieval, so verify current figures via Special:Statistics or the Wikimedia statistics dashboards.*
